blocks.text: The past tense is formed by dropping **-ть** from the infinitive and adding **-л** for the masculine, **-ла** for the feminine, **-ло** for the neuter, **-ли** for the plural: **работал**, **работала**, **работало**, **работали**. Thus, the past does not have special endings for each person, but shows the gender and the number.

Some verbs change the stress in the past tense: **жил**, **жила**, **жило**, **жили**; **спал**, **спала**; **ждал**, **ждала**; **пил**, **пила** — like: **был**, **была**, **было**, **были**. Verbs which have in the infinitive a consonant before **-ть** (**-ти**) or end with **-чь** have the past tense as follows: **есть** — **ел**, **ела**; **идти** — **шёл**, **шла**, **шло**, **шли**; **мочь** — **мог**, **могла**, **могло**, **могли**.
From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 36, 42.
Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: She helped her younger brother finish his picture.
exercises.why: **помочь → помогла** — past tense, fem. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: The Dodgers went on winning with irresistible force.
exercises.why: **продолжать → продолжали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.q: Тоскливый пейзаж ___ (простираться) на многие мили вокруг.
exercises.prompt: A dreary landscape spread out for miles in all directions.
exercises.why: **простираться → простирался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: She wrote me a goodbye letter.
exercises.why: **написать → написала** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.

exercises.prompt: Tom changed his appearance drastically.
exercises.why: **изменить → изменил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Tom's interest quickly waned.
exercises.why: **угаснуть → угас** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: Tom walked into the conference room.
exercises.why: **войти → вошёл** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: He was weak from the loss of blood.
exercises.why: **ослабеть → ослабел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: In the evenings, we played bingo.
exercises.why: **играть → играли** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: Santiago moved to the farm.
exercises.why: **переехать → переехал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: They divorced by mutual agreement.
exercises.why: **развестись → развелись** — past tense, plural (irregular stem).

exercises.q: Когда Аладдин ___ (потереть) волшебную лампу, появился джинн.
exercises.prompt: A genie appeared when Aladdin rubbed the magic lamp.
exercises.why: **потереть → потёр** — past tense, masc. (irregular stem).

exercises.prompt: I could hardly understand him.
exercises.why: **мочь → мог** — past tense, masc.: verbs in -ти / -чь have no -л in the masculine (the other forms do).

exercises.q: Они ___ (убить) этого козла для того, чтобы сделать Богу жертвоприношение.
exercises.prompt: They killed this goat as a sacrifice to God.
exercises.why: **убить → убили** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: Tom made a sand castle.
exercises.why: **построить → построил** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.q: Поверхностный осмотр его зубов ___ (показать), что у него гингивит.
exercises.prompt: A cursory examination of his teeth indicated that he had gingivitis.
exercises.why: **показать → показал** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: I made my way through the crowd.
exercises.why: **пробираться → пробирался** — past tense, masc.: drop -ться, add -лся.

exercises.prompt: Everyone felt it.
exercises.why: **почувствовать → почувствовали** — past tense, plural: drop -ть, add -ли.

exercises.prompt: I saw the constellation of Orion.
exercises.why: **увидеть → увидел** — past tense, masc.: drop -ть, add -л.

exercises.prompt: Mother bought us a puppy.
exercises.why: **купить → купила** — past tense, fem.: drop -ть, add -ла.
